user.password-rule.characters: Only Latin letters, digits and symbols, no spaces
user.password-rule.symbol: At least one symbol, such as ! ? # or @
user.sign-in.name: Name
user.sign-in.notice.account-banned: Your account was banned, so you were signed out. You can sign in again once the ban is lifted.
user.sign-in.notice.resend-after-sign-in: Some changes made on this device had not reached the server when you were signed out. Sign in again to send them.
user.sign-in.notice.signed-out-elsewhere: You were signed out from another device.
user.sign-in.notice.password-changed-els: Your password was changed, so you were signed out. Sign in with the new password.
user.sign-in.notice.device-limit-elsewhe: You were signed out: your account was signed in on more devices than it may be at once, and this one was used least recently.
user.sign-in.device-limit.title: Signed in on too many devices
user.sign-in.device-limit.body: Your account is already signed in on as many devices as it may be at once. To continue, press OK: the device used least recently will be signed out.
user.sign-in.notice.password-reset-elsew: A new password was set in another tab. Sign in with it.
user.sign-in.notice.delete-pending: You are signed out. Your data leaves this device once the other Perch tabs are closed.
user.sign-in.error.email-not-verified: Confirm your email first: open the link in the mail we sent you, or send it again.
user.sign-in.error.sign-up-rejected: An account cannot be created with these details.
user.sign-in.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.sign-in.error.other-account: Another account is signed in on this browser. Sign it out first.
user.sign-in.error.name-too-long: Use at most 80 characters for the name.
user.sign-in.mail.check-your-mail: Check your mail at {email}: open the link in it to confirm your email and sign in. No mail after a few minutes? Send it again, or sign in if you confirmed it already.
user.verify-email.title: Verify your email
user.verify-email.message.verified-befor: This email is verified already. Sign in with your password.
user.verify-email.message.check-your-mai: Check your mail at {email}: if it has an account still to verify, a new link is on its way.
user.verify-email.error.link-invalid: This link does not work. Enter your email to get a new one.
user.verify-email.error.link-expired: This link has expired. Enter your email to get a new one.
user.verify-email.error.other-account: Another account is signed in on this browser. Sign it out first.
user.verify-email.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.forgot-password.title: Forgot your password?
user.forgot-password.hint: Enter the email of your account: we mail you a link that sets a new password.
user.forgot-password.message.check-your-: Check your mail at {email}: if it has an account, a link that sets a new password is on its way. It works for an hour.
user.forgot-password.error.rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.reset-password.title: Set a new password
user.reset-password.message.password-res: Your password is the new one, and every device of your account is signed out. Sign in with the new password.
user.reset-password.error.link-invalid: This link does not work: it was used, or a newer one replaced it.
user.reset-password.error.link-expired: This link has expired: a reset link works for an hour.
user.reset-password.error.password-rejec: This password breaks the rules of a new password.
user.reset-password.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.confirm-email.title: Confirm your new email
user.confirm-email.message.email-changed: Your account's email is the new one: sign in with it from now on.
user.confirm-email.error.link-invalid: This link does not work: it was used, a newer one replaced it, or the account changed since. Ask for a new one in the settings.
user.confirm-email.error.link-expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one in the settings.
user.confirm-email.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.delete-account.title: Delete the account
user.delete-account.warning: This deletes the account this mail was sent to, with its data, signs every device of it out, and deletes the organisations it is the only member of. It cannot be undone.
user.delete-account.message.account-dele: The account is gone, with its data, and every device of it is signed out. Its email can sign up again.
user.delete-account.error.link-invalid: This link does not work: it was used, a newer one replaced it, or the account is gone or changed since. Ask for a new one in the settings.
user.delete-account.error.link-expired: This link has expired: a deletion link works for an hour. Ask for a new one in the settings.
user.delete-account.error.last-admin: This account is the only admin of an organisation that has other members. Make another member an administrator, or remove the others, then press again.
user.delete-account.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.profile.missing: This account has no profile yet.
user.profile.name: Name
user.profile.sign-out-offline.title: Sign out and lose unsent changes?
user.profile.sign-out-offline.body: Some changes made on this device have not reached the server yet. Signing out now deletes them from this device for good.
user.profile.error.bio-too-long: Use at most 2000 characters for the bio.
user.profile.error.failed: The change was not saved. Try again.
user.settings.title: Settings
user.settings.password.title: Password
user.settings.password.error.password-re: This password breaks the rules of a new password.
user.settings.password.error.rate-limite: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour and try again.
user.settings.password.error.failed: The password did not change. Try again.
user.settings.email.title: Email
user.settings.email.message.check-your-m: Check your mail at {email}: open the link in it to make it your email. Until then, your account keeps its email.
user.settings.email.error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour and try again.
user.settings.email.error.failed: The mail was not sent. Try again.
user.settings.deletion.title: Delete the account
user.settings.deletion.warning: The link we mail you deletes the account for good, with its data and the organisations it is the only member of. It cannot be undone. An account that is the only admin of an organisation with other members must first make another member an administrator, or remove the others.
user.settings.deletion.message.check-you: Check your mail: a link that deletes the account is on its way to its email. Nothing changes until you open it and press its button.
user.settings.deletion.error.last-admin: You're the only admin of an organisation that has other members. Make another member an administrator, or remove the others.
user.settings.deletion.error.rate-limite: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour and try again.
user.settings.deletion.error.failed: The mail was not sent. Try again.
